description: Department of Labour - Special Allowance Payable to Workers in the Cocoa, Cardaman and Papper Growing and Manufacturing Trade
categorisation: This gazette notification announces a special allowance payable to workers in specific agricultural trades (cocoa, cardamom, and pepper) based on the Cost of Living Index Number. This falls under public sector services and administration, specifically addressing service conditions and benefits for workers, which aligns with Type 8 (Public Service Gazettes) for public sector service matters and benefits administration.
